title: Name invalid or unavailable staged tree inputs in outgoing task-sync preparation
outcome: A refused staged_tree selection identifies the field, the bad input or unavailable object and the exact corrective staging step.
acceptance: Malformed, unavailable and non-tree staged_tree inputs identify the field and explain how to stage the selected files and pass the full tree ID from git write-tree in the data worktree
Refusal remains before retaining outgoing preparation or custody, and actual Git execution failures retain their own diagnostic
